label: SCG I.22 joined distinct quiddity is not the per se necessary bearer's quiddity
paraphrase: At a selected world, for every bearer x: if x's represented esse e is per se necessary in the dependence sense (PER_SE_NECESSARY_2), x is ontically identified with e, and e is joined to x's proposed quiddity q with q distinct from e as represented principles, then q is not x's genuine quiddity. Conditional on the analyst-coarsened n.2 coverage, n.2's per se clause and horn (iii) accident principle, both n.4 cases, and the accident-not-quiddity premise. It does not assert that x's actual q.3 essence equals its esse, and nothing here asserts that such a bearer exists.
